title: Indonesia’s Merdeka says its gold subsidiary will launch $300M IPO
body: Its flagship mine in Pani Mountain in Sulawesi is estimated to have 7 million ounces of gold resources.

title: Indonesia scraps coal pricing rules after pushback from buyers
body: Miners will now be allowed to sell below government-set benchmarks.

title: Freeport Indonesia to ramp up concentrate exports ahead of ban
body: The firm has exported about 65% of the quota as of mid-August.

title: Nickel surpasses coal as Indonesia’s top export, Macquarie says
body: Earnings from overseas sales of nickel products were $16.5 billion in the first half of the year.

title: Asosiasi Penambang Nikel Indonesia Stresses Importance of Harga Patokan Mineral Compliance in Domestic Nickel Ore Sales
body: The Asosiasi Penambang Nikel Indonesia (APNI) emphasized the need for strict compliance with the Harga Patokan Mineral (HPM) in domestic nickel ore sales, despite existing regulations, to ensure fair transactions and support the sustainability of Indonesia's nickel industry. APNI's efforts aim to promote good governance and marketing strategies among its members, with the goal of enhancing the industry's competitiveness in the global market.

title: Indonesia Emphasizes Regional Collaboration to Boost Electric Vehicle Ecosystem in Southeast Asia
body: The 2nd Automotive Electrical Indonesia Summit highlighted the importance of regional collaboration, business strategy, and sustainable energy models to strengthen the electric vehicle ecosystem in Southeast Asia, with Indonesia poised to become a major production hub. Experts emphasized the need for international cooperation, investment, and innovation to support the growth of the electric vehicle industry, leveraging Indonesia's large market and nickel resources.

title: Nickel Industries Ltd. Expands into Class 1 Nickel Production to Support Electric Vehicle Battery Development
body: Nickel Industries Ltd. has begun operating a project to produce class 1 nickel, a key component in electric vehicle batteries, with plans to integrate it with the local steel and metal industry and achieve commercial production by early 2026. The company's strategy aims to strengthen Indonesia's position in the global electric vehicle supply chain and support the world's energy transition efforts.

title: Indonesia Aims to Dominate Global Nickel and Battery Industries with Strategic National Management
body: Indonesia has the potential to become a major player in the global nickel and battery industries, with over 700 million tons of nickel reserves and 54 smelter facilities, but faces challenges such as raw material availability and import dependence. The country's nickel production is expected to fluctuate, with prices predicted to range from $15,000 to $16,000 next year, and the government is urged to provide strategic solutions to maintain competitiveness and support the national economy.

title: Indonesian Government Evaluates B40 Biodiesel Program Implementation with Mining Industry Stakeholders
body: The Indonesian government, through the Directorate General of New, Renewable, and Energy Conservation, held a discussion with mining industry stakeholders to evaluate the implementation of the B40 biodiesel program, which has increased production costs by 3-5% in the nickel mining sector. The evaluation aims to find solutions to ensure the program's sustainability, considering factors such as global commodity prices and supply chain disruptions, with a focus on flexibility and coordination between industry associations and government agencies.

title: Indonesian Nickel Mining Industry Faces Challenges with B40 Implementation and Declining Nickel Prices
body: The Indonesian nickel mining industry is experiencing difficulties due to the implementation of B40, with production costs increasing by 3-5% and nickel prices reaching a 10-year low of $15,000 per metric ton. The Indonesian Nickel Mining Association (APNI) is calling for a comprehensive evaluation of the B40 policy, citing concerns over supply chain disruptions, decreased profit margins, and reduced tax revenues.

title: Asosiasi Penambang Nikel Indonesia Releases September 2025 Nickel Price Reference with a Decrease to $14.899,64 per dry metric ton
body: The Asosiasi Penambang Nikel Indonesia (APNI) has announced the September 2025 nickel price reference, which has decreased to $14.899,64 per dry metric ton, down from $15.012,67 per dry metric ton in the previous period. The new reference price will serve as a guideline for nickel mining businesses, both for domestic transactions and exports, and will be in effect until the next price setting period.

title: Global Nickel Prices Remain Stable, Mixed Hydroxide Precipitate Sees Significant Increase
body: The Indonesia Nickel Price Index reported stable prices for most nickel products, with the exception of Mixed Hydroxide Precipitate, which saw a significant increase of $97 per metric ton to $12,883 per metric ton. The price stability and increase in MHP reflect the balance of global supply and demand, as well as the growing need for nickel-based battery industry products in Asia, particularly for electric vehicles.

title: Warga Binaan Lapas Nusakambangan Menghasilkan Produk Konstruksi dari Limbah Batu Bara dengan Nilai Ekonomi
body: Warga binaan Lapas Nusakambangan telah menghasilkan produk konstruksi seperti batako, paving block, roaster, dan buis beton dari limbah batu bara dengan kapasitas produksi hingga 2 juta paving block dan 1 juta batako per tahun, berpotensi menghasilkan omzet hingga Rp5,4 miliar per tahun. Program ini merupakan kolaborasi antara Kementerian Imigrasi dan Pemasyarakatan dengan PT PLN dan telah melibatkan 30 warga binaan yang telah aktif dan terampil memproduksi olahan limbah batu bara.

title: Menteri Lingkungan Hidup Applauds PT Vale Indonesia's Progressive and Sustainable Environmental Investment
body: PT Vale Indonesia Tbk has been recognized for its commitment to environmental preservation, having reclaimed 3,800 hectares of land in Sulawesi and operated three hydroelectric power plants with a total capacity of 365 MW. The company has also successfully implemented a 3R principle to manage all hazardous and non-hazardous waste, with 100% of non-hazardous waste being reused in 2024.
